title: NutritionState
description: Dynamic physiological energy, biomass, hydration, and starvation status

stored_energy.description: Current active energy reserve for metabolic and behavioral expenditure

max_energy_capacity.description: Upper capacity limit for stored energy

target_biomass_for_molt.description: Biomass threshold required to trigger the next molt or metamorphic transition

nutrition_quality_index.description: Nutritional quality rating of recently ingested substrate

cumulative_deficit_ticks.description: Total historical ticks spent under nutritional deficit

is_starving.description: True when stored energy is zero and somatic tissue catabolism is active

starvation_ticks_elapsed.description: Consecutive ticks spent in the acute starvation state

catabolized_biomass_total.description: Total structural biomass consumed for emergency survival energy
